name: get_rates
description: Get current exchange rates for a base currency (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR'). Returns conversion rates for all major currencies. Use when you need multiple rates at once.

base_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code to use as the base (e.g., "USD", "EUR", "GBP")

name: get_pair
description: Get the current exchange rate between two specific currencies (e.g., USD to EUR). Returns the conversion rate. Use for single currency pair lookups.
